surface: clean Pd(111), ordered1ML, two fcc-start D per two surface Pd
event_cell_scope: Periodic1x2 ordered reaction-pair array, not an isolated rare recombination event within a larger1ML adlayer

energy_conventions.atomic: E(slab+nH)-E(clean)-nE(spin-polarized H), divided by n; negative favorable
energy_conventions.molecular: E(slab+nH)-E(clean)-n/2 E(computed H2), divided by n; negative favorable
energy_conventions.transport_sign: Eads positive binding is negative molecular adsorption, but is not yet a differential finite-T free energy
energy_conventions.SCF: GPAW extrapolated electronic eV; force-consistent smeared free energies separately retained

pair_occupation: External input; theta squared requires an explicit mean-field independent-site assumption

prefactor.provenance: Analyst-assumed sensitivity range, not literature-calibrated or DFT-predicted
prefactor.normalization: one specified reactive pair; D2 events per pair per second

isotope.mass_role: geometry metadata only; no frequency or prefactor isotope scaling inferred

original_consumer.original_mu_reservoir: half D2 gas at1Pa, finite T
original_consumer.reason_no_automatic_replacement: Electronic adsorption rows do not supply a differential finite-T Langmuir free energy referenced to half D2 at1Pa; front flux has no barrier argument

uncertainty.control_interpretation: Measured fixed-geometry single-point sensitivities, not rigorous error bounds or reoptimized paths
unresolved: lateral periodic reaction-event coupling in the1x2 cell
path image discretization and alternative reaction channels

native_attempt_note: CI-NEB was actually attempted and checkpointed but did not converge; no barrier or rate is inferred from adsorption or unconverged image energies.
